snippet.title: Tile Former Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Tile Former now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5324610/Tile_Former/

Tile Former is a 1-bit puzzle game where the color palette dictates the mechanics. You need to transform the world in various ways and use the palettes at your disposal to solve the puzzles.
